name: Zone of Amicability

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: A 60-foot Emanation of goodwill surrounds you for 10 minutes: when you make an ability check to influence a creature in it, you treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10. It has no effect in a fight; the game's conversations play it out.
